faq.q: What is temporary email, and how does it work?
faq.a: Temporary email is a disposable email address that self-destructs after a set period, allowing you to receive emails without exposing your primary business email, reducing spam and breach risks.

faq.q: Why should small businesses use temporary emails for privacy?
faq.a: Temporary emails help small businesses protect sensitive data by using anonymous addresses for online activities, minimizing exposure to cyberattacks and maintaining communication confidentiality.

faq.q: Is temporary email secure for handling business communications?
faq.a: Yes, when used appropriately, temporary emails add a privacy layer by keeping your main email off public platforms, but for critical communications, use it alongside other security measures.
